tank_dempsey.name: Dunmar Fusewick
tank_dempsey.title: Powder Serjeant
tank_dempsey.description: Lights the fuse first and decides where to throw it second.
tank_dempsey.abilityDesc: Fused Pot — bonus damage vs clustered foes.

richtofen.name: Aldous Verdigris
richtofen.title: Storm-Bottler
richtofen.description: An alchemist thrown out of three guilds for what he keeps in jars.
richtofen.abilityDesc: Bottled Storm — chain lightning on elite hits.

nikolai.name: Otmar Caskwright
nikolai.title: The Cooper
nikolai.description: A cooper banded in his own barrel iron. Hard to open.
nikolai.abilityDesc: Hooped Iron — damage reduction when wounded.

takeo.name: Isen Quillon
takeo.title: Company Fencer
takeo.description: The company's only duelist, and its only clean coat.
takeo.abilityDesc: First Cut — crit chance rises with stars earned.

primis_tank.name: Ser Wulmar Dray
primis_tank.title: Knight of the Barrow Gate
primis_tank.description: First through every barrow door the Vigil has opened.

primis_nikolai.name: Ser Hadwin Morrow
primis_nikolai.title: Keeper of the Tomb Mouth
primis_nikolai.description: Stood in a tomb mouth for a day and a night and let nothing out.
primis_nikolai.abilityDesc: Sealed Door — brief invulnerability pulse below 35% HP.

primis_takeo.name: Dame Ysolt Kerne
primis_takeo.title: Mercy of the Vigil
primis_takeo.description: Ends what the others have started, quickly and without comment.
primis_takeo.abilityDesc: Mercy Stroke — rapid strikes on wounded targets.

primis_richtofen.name: Brother Odrin Wick
primis_richtofen.title: Vigil Leech
primis_richtofen.description: Bleeds the enemy to mend his brothers, and keeps a tally of both.
primis_richtofen.abilityDesc: Candle and Lancet — drains elite HP to heal allies.

master_chief.name: Torvald Greyhame
master_chief.title: Warden-Captain
master_chief.description: Captain of the Greywatch. His shield wall has not been turned.
master_chief.abilityDesc: Pavise Line — shields allies near him on wave start.

noble_six.name: Ashka Lonefell
noble_six.title: Outrider of the Watch
noble_six.description: Scouts alone past the last beacon and prefers it there.
noble_six.abilityDesc: Far from the Fire — bonus damage when isolated.

sgt_johnson.name: Bertram Hobnail
sgt_johnson.title: Drill-Serjeant
sgt_johnson.description: Trained half the watch and has outlived most of it.
sgt_johnson.abilityDesc: Barrack Roar — rally pulse and morale on wave start.

noble_carter.name: Emric Dawnhollow
noble_carter.title: Watch-Lieutenant
noble_carter.description: Chooses the target and lets the others take the shot.
noble_carter.abilityDesc: Call the Mark — buffs nearby Greywatch shooters.

noble_kat.name: Kesta Wirewright
noble_kat.title: Trapsmith
noble_kat.description: Builds the watch's snares and tips its bolts with worse.
noble_kat.abilityDesc: Hobbling Bolt — debuffs enemy accuracy in aura.

noble_emile.name: Rask Notchblade
noble_emile.title: Wall-Clearer
noble_emile.description: The one the watch sends up the ladder first.

noble_jorge.name: Hulbrand Oxbow
noble_jorge.title: Springald Bearer
noble_jorge.description: Carries on one shoulder a bolt-thrower meant for a cart.
noble_jorge.abilityDesc: Springald Shot — splash damage on every third shot.

noble_jun.name: Jessa Stillbreath
noble_jun.title: Tower Marksman
noble_jun.description: Has kept one arrow-slit for eleven winters.
noble_jun.abilityDesc: Held Breath — extreme range, bonus vs elites.

spartan_soldier.name: Greywatch Arbalester
spartan_soldier.title: Citadel Crossbowman
spartan_soldier.description: A rank-and-file crossbowman of the mountain citadel.

marcus_fenix.name: Hale Brandreth
marcus_fenix.title: Company Captain
marcus_fenix.description: Captain of the Sawtooth. Pays late and fights early.
marcus_fenix.abilityDesc: Sawback Glaive — saw-edged finisher on low HP foes.

dom_santiago.name: Derrow Fenn
dom_santiago.title: Shield-Mate
dom_santiago.description: Has stood at the captain's left hand since the first ditch.
dom_santiago.abilityDesc: Stand With Me — heals Hale Brandreth when nearby.

damon_baird.name: Pell Rivetson
damon_baird.title: Company Artificer
damon_baird.description: Knows where every engine is weakest and bills extra for it.
damon_baird.abilityDesc: Pry and Spike — bonus damage vs siege and structures.

augustus_cole.name: Jorram Brakeless
augustus_cole.title: The Battering Man
augustus_cole.description: Runs at the enemy line and trusts it to stop him.
augustus_cole.abilityDesc: Downhill Charge — charges through enemy lines.

anthony_carmine.name: Tam Nockley
anthony_carmine.title: Recruit Crossbowman
anthony_carmine.description: Newest hire in the company, and the one the veterans bet against.
anthony_carmine.abilityDesc: Flag Bolt — fragile, but cheap crossbow support.

clayton_carmine.name: Garrow Twinstring
clayton_carmine.title: Double-Crossbowman
clayton_carmine.description: Built himself a two-stringed crossbow and the arms to draw it.
clayton_carmine.abilityDesc: Bolt Storm — a storm of bolts shreds groups.

benjamin_carmine.name: Odo Perch
benjamin_carmine.title: Tree-Spotter
benjamin_carmine.description: Climbs the nearest tree and whistles where to aim.
benjamin_carmine.abilityDesc: Spotter's Whistle — buffs Tam Nockley and Garrow Twinstring nearby.

cog_soldier.name: Sawtooth Pavisier
cog_soldier.title: Ditch Crossbowman
cog_soldier.description: A hired crossbowman who fights from behind his own plank shield.

aragorn.name: Halvard Roadwarden
aragorn.title: Hedge-Knight Captain
aragorn.description: A landless knight who keeps the pilgrim road for coin and for penance.
aragorn.abilityDesc: Rider's Bane — bonus damage vs elites and dark knights.

legolas.name: Wenna Marshbow
legolas.title: Fenland Longbow
legolas.description: A fowler's daughter who can take a snipe on the wing at dusk.
legolas.abilityDesc: Long Draw — extreme range, bonus vs fast foes.

gimli.name: Dorn Quarrykin
gimli.title: Quarry Axeman
gimli.description: Splits siege timbers the way he once split stone.
gimli.abilityDesc: Splitting Stroke — splash on siege targets.

gandalf.name: Father Tolland
gandalf.title: Road-Priest
gandalf.description: Blesses the road ahead with salt and curses whatever stands on it.
gandalf.abilityDesc: Ward of Salt — terrifies nearby enemies.

frodo.name: Nib Thimblewick
frodo.title: Company Runner
frodo.description: A cutpurse the company caught and kept for his feet.
frodo.abilityDesc: Underfoot — evasion and morale aura for allies.

boromir.name: Gerent Gatesby
boromir.title: Gate-Serjeant
boromir.description: Held a toll-gate against raiders, alone, until the company arrived.
boromir.abilityDesc: Hold the Gate — rally pulse when surrounded.

eowyn.name: Marta Hobblethorn
eowyn.title: Troll-Hunter
eowyn.description: Hunts the big ones for the bounty and goes for the tendon.
eowyn.abilityDesc: Hamstring Thrust — devastating finisher vs elite foes.

baki_hanma.name: Kell Splitlip
baki_hanma.title: Lodge Prodigy
baki_hanma.description: The youngest fighter to win the lodge's knucklebones.
baki_hanma.abilityDesc: Blooded — damage spikes when below half HP.

yujiro_hanma.name: Morgash Skullhand
yujiro_hanma.title: Master of the Lodge
yujiro_hanma.description: Has never lost a bout and has stopped being offered them.
yujiro_hanma.abilityDesc: Bare-Handed Ruin — near-boss tier melee devastation.

doppo_orochi.name: Hesk Hardpalm
doppo_orochi.title: Lodge Instructor
doppo_orochi.description: Teaches one blow, and has taught it for forty years.
doppo_orochi.abilityDesc: Callus Strike — precision strikes on wounded targets.

jack_hanma.name: Grudd Filetooth
jack_hanma.title: The Gnawer
jack_hanma.description: Filed his teeth to points and uses them.
jack_hanma.abilityDesc: Gnaw — bonus damage vs larger enemies.

oliva_biscuit.name: Tunn Oxhide
oliva_biscuit.title: The Anvil

kaku_kaioh.name: Wend Reedhand
kaku_kaioh.title: The Yielding Reed
kaku_kaioh.description: Gives way to every blow and sends it back harder.

pickle.name: Uggar No-Tongue
pickle.title: The Feral
pickle.description: Found wild in the hill caves. The lodge feeds him and aims him.

jonathan_joestar.name: Ser Anselm Dawnmere
jonathan_joestar.title: Sunrise Templar

jonathan_joestar.abilityDesc: Dawn Hymn — bonus vs undead elites.

dio_brando_p1.name: Veyra Coldcloister
dio_brando_p1.title: Fallen Cantor

zeppeli.name: Tiber Wellspring
zeppeli.title: Wandering Hymnist
zeppeli.description: An old road-singer who hums over wounds until they close.
zeppeli.abilityDesc: Mending Verse — heals allies on elite kill.

joseph_joestar_p2.name: Dallow Tripwire
joseph_joestar_p2.title: Hedge-Trapper
joseph_joestar_p2.description: Lays a snare first and picks the fight second.
joseph_joestar_p2.abilityDesc: Snare Verse — trick shots and scouting debuffs.

caesar_zeppeli.name: Cael Slingsong
caesar_zeppeli.title: Choir Slinger
caesar_zeppeli.description: Drills his sling-stones so they whistle on the way in.

stroheim.name: Gaunt Ironrib
stroheim.title: Braced Zealot
stroheim.description: Wears a ram's iron head on his chest and walks into siege engines.
stroheim.abilityDesc: Ram's Canticle — bonus vs siege units.

jotaro_kujo.name: Corvin Stonepsalm
jotaro_kujo.title: Choir Enforcer
jotaro_kujo.description: Collects what the choir is owed, one verse per blow.

kakyoin.name: Neve Shardglass
kakyoin.title: Reliquary Scatterer

polnareff.name: Aubrin Needlepoint
polnareff.title: Choir Fencer
polnareff.description: A thin blade and thinner patience.
polnareff.abilityDesc: Needle Verse — flurry attacks on low HP foes.

avdol.name: Hesper Brazier
avdol.title: Thurifer
avdol.description: Swings a censer of live coals on a long chain.

josuke_higashikata.name: Brother Linden Salve
josuke_higashikata.title: Bone-Mender

josuke_higashikata.abilityDesc: Knitting Hymn — heals allies he passes.

okuyasu.name: Dunnock Heavyhand
okuyasu.title: Bell-Ringer

rohan_kishibe.name: Sister Quillane
rohan_kishibe.title: Curse-Scribe

kira_yoshikage.name: Hollis Greyglove
kira_yoshikage.title: Quiet Verger

kira_yoshikage.abilityDesc: Unsung End — final toll on wounded foes.

giorno_giovanna.name: Aurel Thornbloom
giorno_giovanna.title: Choir Almoner

giorno_giovanna.abilityDesc: Alms of Blood — heals allies on kill.

bruno_bucciarati.name: Marrec Tallcandle
bruno_bucciarati.title: Precentor

guido_mista.name: Tobble Skipstone
guido_mista.title: Skip-Shot Slinger
guido_mista.description: Skips a stone off one skull and into the next.
guido_mista.abilityDesc: Skipping Stone — ricochet shots hit multiple foes.

diavolo.name: Serrec Hoodwell
diavolo.title: Choir Headsman
diavolo.description: No one in the choir has seen under the hood.
diavolo.abilityDesc: Final Amen — ends wounded targets outright.

jolyne_cujoh.name: Wren Catgut
jolyne_cujoh.title: String-Binder
jolyne_cujoh.description: Strings her snares with the choir's broken harp-gut.

weather_report.name: Harrow Cloudcall

weather_report.description: Sings the versicle. The sky gives the response.

ermes_costello.name: Brannet Doublet
ermes_costello.title: Refrain-Fighter
ermes_costello.description: Hits the same place twice, then twice again.
ermes_costello.abilityDesc: Refrain — doubles pressure on elite kills.

johnny_joestar.name: Ilsa Longspur
johnny_joestar.title: Choir Outrider

gyro_zeppeli.name: Garrin Flailwheel
gyro_zeppeli.title: Flail Rider

diego_brando.name: Hask Wolfsaddle
diego_brando.title: Hound-Master Rider

lucy_steel.name: Pella Ribbonmane

lucy_steel.abilityDesc: Riding Hymn — support cavalry rally aura.

kenshiro.name: Sevrin Palmquiet

raoh.name: Gorhame the Unbowed
raoh.title: Abbot-Militant
raoh.description: Took the order's vows and kept all but the one about peace.
raoh.abilityDesc: Heavy Tread — terror aura and siege bonus.

toki.name: Ellit Softpalm
toki.title: Infirmarian
toki.description: Mends with the same hands the order taught him to kill with.
toki.abilityDesc: Laying On of Hands — heals allies in aura.

rei.name: Sorrel Scytheheel
rei.title: Sweeping Monk
rei.description: Fights in long sweeping kicks, barefoot, in any weather.
rei.abilityDesc: Scything Step — fast strikes on multiple foes.

jaggi.name: Lorn Spitgravel
jaggi.title: Expelled Novice
jaggi.description: Thrown out of the order for the tricks he still uses.
jaggi.abilityDesc: Grit in the Eye — debuffs enemy morale on hit.

shin.name: Castrel Spearhand
shin.title: Finger of the Order
shin.description: Trained one stiffened hand for twenty years. It goes through mail.

goku.name: Tavish Coalheart

goku.description: Laughs in a fight, and burns hottest with enemies all round him.
goku.abilityDesc: Ember Burst — burst finisher when surrounded.

vegeta.name: Raddoc Proudflame

vegeta.description: Second-best in the warband and unable to forgive it.
vegeta.abilityDesc: Banked Fury — bonus vs elites, pride damage boost.

piccolo.name: Varrow Cindersight

gohan.name: Emmet Kindling
gohan.title: Untested Blood
gohan.description: The warband's youngest. Nothing much until he is hurt.

trunks.name: Isk Farflame
trunks.title: Ember-Slinger

frieza.name: Selka Whiteash

frieza.description: Burns white and quiet, and never wastes a second blow.

cell.name: Gulch the Glutton
cell.title: Flame-Eater
cell.description: Feeds his fire on whatever falls in front of him.

beerus.name: Mother Scoria
beerus.title: The Pyre
beerus.description: The oldest fire in the warband. The others bank theirs when she wakes.
beerus.abilityDesc: Pyre's End — ends wounded foes outright.

chapter_captain.name: Ivo Harrowgate
chapter_captain.title: Knight-Castellan
chapter_captain.description: Commands the order's line by the verse and the count.
chapter_captain.abilityDesc: Ordered Volley — bonus damage with allied Psalm brothers nearby.

chaplain.name: Brother Malloch
chaplain.title: Psalm-Warden
chaplain.description: Sings the wrathful psalms and keeps time with a mace.
chaplain.abilityDesc: Psalm of Wrath — terrifies nearby foes on strike.

librarian.name: Sister Ottoline Reed
librarian.title: Hex-Finder
librarian.description: Keeps the order's list of witches and crosses the names off herself.
librarian.abilityDesc: Unbinding — bonus damage vs arcane and undead casters.

commissar.name: Provost Kerrick
commissar.title: Field Provost
commissar.description: Pays those who run, theirs or ours, the same coin.
commissar.abilityDesc: Deserter's Wage — finishes routed, low-HP enemies.

guardsman.name: Iron Psalm Levy
guardsman.title: Levy Crossbowman
guardsman.description: A tithed villager with a crossbow and a psalm book.
guardsman.abilityDesc: Levy Volley — steady ranged line-holder with splash volleys.

terminator.name: Brother Hulm
terminator.title: Tower-Shield Brother
terminator.description: Carries a door of oak and iron and stands behind it.
terminator.abilityDesc: Tower Shield — damage reduction pulse when wounded.

dreadnought.name: Tobiah Bronzeback
dreadnought.title: The Bell-Cannon
dreadnought.description: Carries a recast church bell on his back and fires it.
dreadnought.abilityDesc: Bronze Bombard — devastates siege engines and structures.

soldier_of_light.name: Davin Glasswright
soldier_of_light.title: Guild Blade
soldier_of_light.description: The guild's hired sword, paid in glass and loyal for it.
soldier_of_light.abilityDesc: Crosswise Cut — finisher damage vs wounded foes.

black_mage.name: Obsidia Kiln
black_mage.title: Kiln-Witch
black_mage.description: Keeps a furnace's heat in a bottle and breaks it over crowds.
black_mage.abilityDesc: Kiln Burst — burst fire when enemies cluster.

white_mage.name: Elowen Saltmere
white_mage.title: Guild Physic
white_mage.description: Treats burns and cuts, the guild's two trades.
white_mage.abilityDesc: Clear Glass — heals allies in combat aura.

dragoon_knight.name: Corbet Highvault
dragoon_knight.title: Vaulting Lancer
dragoon_knight.description: Vaults from the saddle on his lance and comes down point first.
dragoon_knight.abilityDesc: Vaulting Lance — bonus vs fast and flying foes.

summoner.name: Thessaly Prism
summoner.title: Lens-Caller
summoner.description: Gathers daylight through a great lens and lays it on one target.
summoner.abilityDesc: Burning Lens — bonus damage vs elite enemies.

limit_striker.name: Harl Crackglaze
limit_striker.title: The Flawed Blade
limit_striker.description: Cracked in the firing, the guild says. Most dangerous when breaking.
limit_striker.abilityDesc: Shatter Point — massive spike when wounded.

crystal_sentinel.name: Guild Shardbow
crystal_sentinel.title: Glass-Bolt Crossbowman
crystal_sentinel.description: A guild crossbowman shooting glass-headed bolts.
crystal_sentinel.abilityDesc: Shard Bolt — reliable budget ranged DPS.

chaos_champion.name: Hesker Rawhand
chaos_champion.title: Chosen of the Wound
chaos_champion.description: Keeps his own wounds open as an offering.
chaos_champion.abilityDesc: Red Frenzy — damage surges when wounded.

plague_cultist.name: Pox-Sister Marrin
plague_cultist.title: Bearer of Sores
plague_cultist.description: Carries the cult's sickness gladly and shares it.
plague_cultist.abilityDesc: Weeping Sore — slows and breaks enemy morale.

warp_magus.name: Ezrin Splitveil
warp_magus.title: Wound-Seer
warp_magus.description: Sees through the wound in the world and curses what he finds.
warp_magus.abilityDesc: Forked Curse — arcs to a second nearby foe.

daemon_knight.name: Ser Culloch the Flensed
daemon_knight.title: The Healed-Over
daemon_knight.description: His armour has healed onto him.
daemon_knight.abilityDesc: Scabbed Plate — brief damage soak below 40% HP.

heretic_acolyte.name: Nym Bloodcup
heretic_acolyte.title: Cup-Bearer
heretic_acolyte.description: Carries the cult's cup and fills it where he can.

possessed_marine.name: Brannoc Ashquarrel
possessed_marine.title: Turncoat Crossbowman
possessed_marine.description: Deserted an honest company. His quarrels have burned ever since.
possessed_marine.abilityDesc: Wound-Fire Bolts — splash vs elite targets.

dragonborn.name: Hrafna Stormthroat
dragonborn.title: Voice of the Warband
dragonborn.description: Her war-howl has broken shield walls before a blow was struck.
dragonborn.abilityDesc: Breaking Howl — force wave devastates clustered foes.

greybeard_sage.name: Skegga Hoarfrost
greybeard_sage.title: Cairn-Chanter
greybeard_sage.description: Chants from the cairn-top. The warband fights to his rhythm.
greybeard_sage.abilityDesc: Echoing Chant — empowers allies and weakens nearby foes on wave start.

nord_huscarl.name: Bodmar Lindenshield
nord_huscarl.title: Hearth-Guard
nord_huscarl.description: Sworn to stand between the hearth and whatever comes for it.
nord_huscarl.abilityDesc: Hold Fast — damage reduction when holding the line.

battlemage.name: Sigrith Hailcaller
battlemage.title: Storm-Seer
battlemage.description: Calls hail down on anything bigger than she is.
battlemage.abilityDesc: Hail Call — storm magic bonus vs elites and bosses.

nightingale.name: Yrsel Nightfoot
nightingale.title: Night Raider
nightingale.description: Raids alone after dark and comes back with other men's rings.
nightingale.abilityDesc: Knife in the Dark — bonus crit damage vs wounded targets.

restoration_saint.name: Hervild Hearthmender
restoration_saint.title: Hearth-Mother
restoration_saint.description: Keeps the warband's fire, its wounded and its nerve.
restoration_saint.abilityDesc: Hearth Blessing — steady morale and healing aura.
